notes.title: Please please please leave a review... please!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39934514/c81c55ea82b98becce50989fe2d1088dbd2a4c56.jpg

Since releasing Lucy Dreaming last year, we've seen incredible support and love for our very first commercial game. We reached 100 reviews really quickly, but we need more, and here's why...

Did you know...
...the vast majority of new players will come via suggestions made by Steam within their own platform? Steam's algorithm uses the number of reviews to dictate how often (and how prominently) each game is shown to new potential players as they browse and play.

...the first algorithm milestone is 10 reviews.
This is basically Steam's way of making sure that a game isn't a complete crash-fest.

...next is at 50-reviews.
This is where a game can earn its Very Positive rating, depending on the positivity of the reviews.

...the next milestone is a whopping 500 reviews!
This would give us an Overwhelmingly Positive rating and a top spot in Steam's algorithm. We're already over 30% of the way there, but every single review counts and improves our chances of being displayed to more potential point & click fans.

What can you do?
It's simple, and only takes a minute! If you have enjoyed playing Lucy Dreaming, please, please, please spare a few seconds to write a short review and help us to reach that magic 500 reviews!

It really will have an enormous impact, and enable us to create more games in the future.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1532710/Lucy_Dreaming/

Thank you, and I really hope you've enjoyed playing our game.

Tom x

notes.title: Introducing: Heir of the Dog
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39934514/0c32cfb898bab1feaeed0cd6ec1be1ca5d5a424d.jpg

If you have followed my journey into game development over the past few years, you'll probably be aware of Hair of the Dog, a short adventure game I created for AdvXJam back in 2020. It was created in twelve days, so was a little rough around the edges, but pipped Lucy Dreaming to the post as the first game I ever released on Steam. In that respect it was a great test-run, paving the way for Lucy two years later.

Hair of the Dog has enjoyed over 25,000 downloads on various platforms since it was released, and I have received hundreds of messages and reviews from people all over the world requesting a full length version.

Well, here it is!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2431920/Heir_of_the_Dog/

Heir of the Dog will return to the fog-covered streets of Victorian London to expand on the life of Cummerbund Bandersnatch and his curious condition.

[previewyoutube=Sf4RvyPpPMg;full][/previewyoutube]

Demo coming soon!
The demo is tantalisingly almost finished, with the voices being recorded as I type, but that shouldn't stop anyone from adding it to their wishlist (we all know how the Steam algorithm loves a wishlist!)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39934514/3a0c17fafb7afdf40f6b42adc88852e3318debf7.png

The demo is predominantly a recreation of the original Game Jam game from 2020 so, if you've played it before, the majority of the puzzles and dialogue will be familiar to you, but I have applied everything I learned whilst developing Lucy Dreaming in terms of the improved UI, controller support and artwork. So, even if you have met Cummerbund before, why not clear the fog with a stroll down Memory Lane when the demo is released. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39934514/2845656f71e433240579717ebd4124303336bea4.png

Add it to your wishlist now

notes.title: Lucy Dreaming Soundtrack now available
notes.content:
Since releasing Lucy Dreaming back in October 2023, people have fallen in love with its retro soundtrack produced in both AdLib Sound Blaster and Roland MT32 styles.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2462140/Lucy_Dreaming_Soundtrack/

We are now delighted to announce that we have made the full soundtrack available to download as DLC on Steam!

[previewyoutube=dMxT3IdwbCM;full][/previewyoutube]Listen to some samples

Here's what you get

 26 original tracks from Lucy Dreaming
 2 bonus tracks never used in the final game
 Both Roland MT32 and AdLib sound card styles for each track
 High quality FLAC and MP3 formats


The genius behind the music
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39934514/9343bdf94504c34eab43a58bc330f807ef8a4a02.jpg
Bertrand Guégan is a composer and teacher specialising in orchestral, metal and acoustic music. He has a real soft spot for retro video games from the "golden age" and, growing up in the 1990s, he enjoyed music through the soundcards available at the time, the AdLib Sound Blaster, and Roland MT32.

His passion for point & click adventure games shines through in this collection of atmospheric soundscapes from Lucy's dream worlds and her hometown of Figgington, all available in both soundcard styles.

Find out more about Bertrand here

notes.title: Fixes and a slightly adapted ending
notes.content:
Some fixes

 Small typos
 Steam achievement fix for one of the badges - if you earned a badge but didn't earn the Steam achievement to go along with it, you can load up a savegame with the badge and Steam will reward you accordingly (alternatively, you can just earn it again if you prefer) :)
 Fixes to some clickable hotspots (one which caused a DMW dead end!)
 A patch to prevent the unintentional "Spiderman" easter egg which allowed Lucy to climb some walls.


Known issues

 Mac - On some Macs with Apple Silicon, the mouse can get a bit stuck in one corner of the screen. We are working on a fix for this.
 Linux - Audio can distort or judder on some systems, try disabling surround sound if this occurs.
 Windows - The game rarely, but occasionally crashes with no log or report. We believe this is caused by graphics drivers on some machines. If it happens, you chould be able to continue from when you entered the last scene with the autosave.


A small change to the ending
The ending has been tweaked slightly. I don't want to go into detail as tit will contain spoilers, but if you want to read about it, there is a comment thread on Steam which goes into some detail.

Tom

notes.title: Only one day to go...
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39934514/9beb927fdd86158de50c42a74523bb35cba2501a.jpg

Lucy Dreaming is a retro British point & click adventure packed with nightmares, mystery, jam and weasels. Here are some things to look forward to...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39934514/63cde1a93d928a7430f3dd0b817dc5ebc8e336a6.jpg

A traditional-feeling game with tonnes of modern features.
Lucy Dreaming is very much a love-letter to the 1990s classic LucasArts adventure games, with a visible inventory and a pared-down verb-based interface like you'd find in the original Monkey Island games.
But we've also added some more features to make exploring the game easier and quicker for those of us with busy lives.

Get all nostalgia, with none of the frustration (unless you hate puzzles of course).


 Over 11,000 lines of fully-voiced and lip-synced dialogue.
 A hotspot finder: Hold down the space bar or press the ? at the bottom to reveal the important objects in each scene.
 Double-click any exit to leave that scene immediately.
 Collect in-game badges and Steam achievements.
 A range of keyboard hot keys to select commands, skip text/cutscenes, access your map and change audio/display settings.
 Multiple music styles: Press "M" or access the audio menu during the game to toggle between AdLib Sound Blaster and Roland MT32 music styles.
 12 savegame slots.
 German subtitles and UI.
 Gamepad support
 All game design, writing, artwork and development was the work of a single indie dev!


Even Monkey Island's creator has it on his wishlist!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39934514/e831e7bacb4e27e8c434ad77cf94fe6e2a2ba58a.png


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39934514/90ec327060a38b320c0478a18a423ffcec0e898a.jpg

A generous 15% launch discount!
That's right, the game will already be reasonably priced (bearing in mind the 10-12 hours average game length), but that's not enough! For the first week, we'll be releasing the game with a staggering 15% off.

Add it to your wishlist now and don't miss out!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1532710/Lucy_Dreaming/

notes.title: Lucy Dreaming: A pixel-art point & click adventure
notes.content:
Lucy Dreaming is planned for release in Summer 2022!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39934514/c0114e7116a8a5dbaedfb1850eca3d4b1a5a3fb5.jpg

What to expect
Lucy Dreaming is a retro point & click adventure with a fully-voiced cast, stunning pixel-art and a witty British sense of humour inspired by the likes of Blackadder and Monty Python.
The full game opens up a myriad of dream worlds with extraordinary characters and logical puzzles as Lucy strives to unearth the disturbing truth behind her nightmares...but before that, she needs to overcome her anxiety and get to sleep.

That's your quest in the Lucy Dreaming demo/prequel, and your springboard into the wider adventure ahead.
[hr][/hr]“I don’t think I’ve ever laughed as much playing a game as I did playing this.”
“Lucy Dreaming’s puzzle design is genius, fun and incredibly satisfying to solve. The level of detail afforded to each item in Lucy Dreaming is exquisite and an incredible accomplishment.
Game Crater - Read the full review
[hr][/hr]Discover the origins and story behind the game
Join reviewer and YouTuber TurianShepard for a revealing interview with British indie developer, artist and writer behind Lucy Dreaming  - Tom Hardwidge.
We'll be discussing everything from the initial concept through to the artwork and development leading to the game's release this summer. So grab a nice cup of tea and join us for a chinwag about this charming, British point & click comedy.
[hr][/hr]Played the demo yet?
If you're worried about repeating puzzles or spoilers for the full game, fear not! The demo prequel for Lucy Dreaming is packed with its own unique puzzles, offering spoiler-free fun for seasoned adventurers and newcomers alike.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1532710/Lucy_Dreaming/

Don't forget to add Lucy Dreaming to your wishlist!

notes.title: Now available in German, Spanish, Italian and Russian
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39934514/b33737c9a4035f7edb0e44f77d48eef5c44962b7.jpg

We have just released a version of the Lucy Dreaming demo with an interface and subtitles localised for German, Spanish, Italian and Russian speakers!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39934514/77c9e0ead689c74e44decee42513262cc9b7a609.png

Thank you!
Due to the comparatively low budget that we've had to work to on the demo itself, the localisation has been kindly done for us by adventure game fans and other indie game developers who believe in the game!

Feedback
If you spot anything in one of the new languages which seems out of place, or could be improved, please send us a message. It may be just a demo, but we want it to be the best it can be!

Saved games
Also, we have tested the game saving functionality in the new release against games saved with the previous release and, although we found everything to work correctly when tested, there's a possibility that some saved games may reveal a few bugs with the audio and text outputs. If this occurs, I'm afraid that you may have to start the demo again. At least it's only a relatively short game!

We're still on Kickstarter!
We funded within one week, but we're still reaching for our stretch goals until 26th May. If you haven't backed the game already, head on over to our Kickstarter page.

Tom

notes.title: Easter egg hunt
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39934514/49becf145eb1495689a8ab5b88cc73acacff0713.png

Have you ever wanted to be a character in an adventure game?
Now's your chance!

The demo for Lucy Dreaming contains a well-hidden Easter egg that unlocks the chance to win big.

Its discovery offers adventure gamers a once-in-a-lifetime chance to appear as a pixel-art character in the full release of the game.

Every player who finds the Easter egg is offered the chance to enter a draw where the prize is unlike any other – become an NCP (non-player character) in the full game!

Not only will their likeness be rendered seamlessly into the beautiful, retro pixel-art world of Lucy Dreaming, they will also become an integral part of the game’s story and gameplay. In addition to this, the winner will receive a free digital copy of the full game, a high-resolution digital artwork of their character and a mention in the game’s credits to boot.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39934514/12921aab56b4f86a47490c54e564b36fec3e496b.jpg

Lucy Dreaming is a comedic, quirky point & click adventure which sees players taking control of the destiny of Lucy, a young girl suffering from recurring nightmares. In the game Lucy unlocks the secrets to controlling her dreams and journeys through a myriad of weird & wonderful locations in both the real world and her dreams. On the way she encounters a cast of extraordinary characters and creatures as she unearths the disturbing truth behind her nightmares.

So what are you waiting for? Go and find that egg!

Full details can be found on the Lucy Dreaming website: https://lucy-dreaming.com/egg/ 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1542220

notes.title: Play the FREE Lucy Dreaming demo now
notes.content:
We can announce that our first fully-fledged adventure game, Lucy Dreaming, is now available as a demo  with a Kickstarter campaign launching in May.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1542220

This pixel art adventure is laden with irreverent and sardonic British humour inspired by Blackadder and Monty Python, and is bought to life with a wildly entertaining voice cast led by our own studio founder Emma. A love letter to classic LucasArts point & click adventures, the game is unashamedly traditional but with all the modern bells and whistles of other games in the genre.  

Game features:


 Discover a wide variety of detailed dreams and real-world locations from a neon-lit comedy club with an unusual clientele to a post-apocalyptic boulangerie.
 Encounter a cast of characters from Lucy’s maniacal brother to a giant duck with a bread problem.
 Explore rich environments with an abundance of witty retorts to almost everything you can point your cursor at.
